questions.question: By selling an article for Rs 255, there is a loss of 15%. When the article is sold for Rs 357, the net result in the transaction is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling price of an article = Rs 255

Loss percentage = 15%

**Concept Used:**

Cost Price = (100)/(100-Loss\%)times SP

Profit % = (Profit)/(CP)times 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Cost Price of an article = (100)/(100-15)times 255

⇒ Cost Price of an article = (100)/(85)times 255=300 Rs

⇒ When article is sold at Rs 357,

⇒ Profit = SP – CP = 357 – 300 = Rs 57

⇒ Profit % = (57)/(300)times 100=19\%

**Hence, the net result in the transaction is 19% profit.**

questions.question: Kuldeep offers his customers a discount of 10% on the marked price of a suitcase and he still makes a profit of 20%. What is the actual cost of the suitcase marked for Rs 2,500?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked Price of suitcase = Rs 2,500

Discount = 10%

Profit % = 20%

**Concept Used:**

Cost Price = (100)/(100+Profit\%)times SP

**Calculation:**

⇒ Selling Price of suitcase = MP – Discount % of MP

⇒ Selling Price = 2500 – 10% of 2500 = 2500-(10)/(100)times 2500=2500-250=2250 Rs

According to the question, it makes profit of 20%

⇒ So, Cost Price of suitcase = (100)/(100+20)times 2250=(100)/(120)times 2250

⇒ Cost Price = (10)/(12)times 2250=10times 187.5=Rs 1875

**Hence, the cost price of a suitcase is Rs 1875**

questions.question: After spending 20% of his salary on grocery and 30% of the remainder on monthly house rent, a man is left with Rs 8,400. What is his monthly salary?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Percentage of salary spent on grocery = 20%

Percentage of salary spent of house rent = 30%

Left Amount = Rs 8400

**Concept Used:**

Monthly Salary = Expenditures + Savings

**Calculation:**

Let the monthly salary of man be Rs x

⇒ Amount left after spending on grocery = x – 20% of x = x-(20)/(100)times x=(5x-x)/(5)=(4x)/(5)

⇒ Now, Amount left after spending on house rent = (4x)/(5)-(30)/(100)times (4x)/(5)=(4x)/(5)-(6x)/(25)

⇒ Amount left after spending on house rent = (20x-6x)/(25)=(14x)/(25)

 According to question,

⇒ (14x)/(25)=8400

⇒ x=(8400times 25)/(14)=15000

**Hence, the monthly salary of a man is Rs 15,000**

questions.question: A car travelled distances of 10 km, 20 km and 30 km at speeds of 30 km/h, 40 km/h and 60 km/h, respectively. The average speed of the car is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distances = 10 km, 20 km, 30 km

Speeds = 30 km/h, 40 km/h, 60 km/h

**Concept Used:**

**Time=(Distance)/(Speed)**

**Calculation:**

⇒ Time taken for the distance of 10 km = (10)/(30)=(1)/(3) hours

⇒ Time taken for the distance of 20 km = (20)/(40)=(1)/(2) hours

⇒ Time taken for the distance of 30 km = (30)/(60)=(1)/(2) hours

⇒ Total Distance = 10 + 20 + 30 = 60 km

⇒ Average Speed of car = (60)/(frac{1){3}+(1)/(2)+(1)/(2)}=(60)/(1+frac{1){3}}

⇒ Average Speed of car = (60)/(frac{4){3}}=(60times 3)/(4)=45km/h

**Hence, the average speed of the car is 45 km/h.**

questions.question: If x = sqrt {10} + sqrt {11} , y = sqrt {10} - sqrt {11} , then value of 7x² - 50xy + 7y² = ___________.
questions.solution:

x = sqrt{10} + sqrt{11} 

y = sqrt{10}-sqrt{11} 

**Concept Used:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

(a – b)² = a² + b² – 2ab

(a + b)(a – b) = a² – b²

**Calculation:**

⇒ 7x² – 50xy + 7y² 

⇒ 7(sqrt{10}+sqrt{11} )² – 50 (sqrt{10}+sqrt{11} )(sqrt{10}-sqrt{11} ) + 7(sqrt{10}-sqrt{11} )²

⇒ 7[(sqrt{10})²+(sqrt{11})²+2times sqrt{10}times sqrt{11}] – 50[(sqrt{10})²-(sqrt{11})²] + 7[(sqrt{10})²+(sqrt{11})²-2times sqrt{10}times sqrt{11}]

⇒ 7(10 + 11 + 2sqrt{110}) – 50(10 – 11) + 7(10 + 11 – 2sqrt{110})

⇒ 147 + 14sqrt{110} + 50 + 147 – 14sqrt{110}

⇒ 344

**∴ The value of the given expression is 344**

questions.question: The distance between stations A and B is 778 kilometres. A train travels from station A to station B at a uniform speed of 84 km/h and then returns to station A at a uniform speed of 56 km/h. What is the train's average speed (in km/h) throughout the journey?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When the distance is constant for both parts of a journey, Average Speed = 2xy ÷ (x + y)

⇒ Forward speed (x) = 84 km/h, Return speed (y) = 56 km/h

⇒ Average speed = (2 × 84 × 56) ÷ (84 + 56)

⇒ Average speed = (2 × 84 × 56) ÷ 140

⇒ Average speed = 9408 ÷ 140 = 67.2 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 67.2 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Distance between stations A and B = 778 km

⇒ Forward speed (v₁) = 84 km/h

⇒ Return speed (v₂) = 56 km/h

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

⇒ Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total Distance for the round trip = 778 + 778 = 1556 km

⇒ Time taken from A to B = 778 ÷ 84 hours

⇒ Time taken from B to A = 778 ÷ 56 hours

⇒ Total Time = (778 ÷ 84) + (778 ÷ 56)

⇒ Taking 778 common, Total Time = 778 × (1/84 + 1/56)

⇒ LCM of 84 and 56 is 168. Therefore, 1/84 + 1/56 = (2 + 3) ÷ 168 = 5 ÷ 168

⇒ Total Time = (778 × 5) ÷ 168 hours

⇒ Average Speed = 1556 ÷ [(778 × 5) ÷ 168]

⇒ Average Speed = (1556 × 168) ÷ (778 × 5)

⇒ Average Speed = (2 × 168) ÷ 5 = 336 ÷ 5 = 67.2 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 67.2 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for Unequal Distances

When different distances are covered at varying speeds, the direct formula cannot be used. Always apply the base formula: Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time.

Average Speed for Three Equal Distances

If a vehicle covers three equal parts of a journey at speeds x, y, and z respectively, the overall average speed is calculated as: 3xyz ÷ (xy + yz + zx).

Relative Speed Concept

When two objects move towards each other (opposite directions), their Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂. When moving in the same direction, Relative Speed = |S₁ − S₂|.

questions.question: Number B is 17.5% less than number A, while number C is 22.5% more than number B. If the value of C is given as 8085, what is the value of A?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Value of C = 8085

Value of C = 22.5% more than B

Value of B = 17.5% less than A

**Calculation:**

As given, C = 8085

⇒ Let the value of B be x

⇒ Value of C = x + 22.5% of x

⇒ x+(22.5)/(100)times x=8085

⇒ 122.5x=808500

⇒ x=(808500)/(122.5)=6600 Rs

Now, let the value of A be y

⇒ Value of B = y – 17.5% of y

⇒ 6600=y-(17.5)/(100)times y=(82.5y)/(100)

⇒ y=(6600times 100)/(82.5)=80times 100 = 8000 Rs

**Hence, the value of A is Rs 8,000**

questions.question: The surface area of a volleyball spherical is 100π cm². Find the volume of air enclosed in the ball.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Surface area of sphere = 100π cm²

**Concept Used:**

Surface Area of Sphere = 4pi r²

Volume of Sphere = (4)/(3)pi r³

**Calculation:**

⇒ Surface Area of spherical volleyball = 100π cm²

⇒ 4pi r²=100pi

⇒ r²=(100pi)/(4pi)=25

⇒ r=sqrt{25}=5

⇒ Now, Volume of air enclosed in the ball = (4)/(3)pi times 5³=(4)/(3)pi times 125

⇒ Volume of air enclosed in the ball = (500)/(3)pi cm³

**Hence, the volume of air enclosed in the ball is (500)/(3)pi** **cm³.**

⇒ 9 × 12 ÷ 2 - 5 × Q + 2 × 3 = 10

⇒ 9 × 6 - 5 × Q + 2 × 3 = 10

⇒ 54 - 5Q + 6 = 10

⇒ 5Q = 60 – 10 = 50

⇒ Q=(50)/(5)=10

**Hence, the value of Q is 10**

questions.question: The average of the four numbers, given in a particular order, is 48. The average of the first three numbers is 42, while the average of the last three numbers is 50. What is the average of the first and last number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of four numbers = 48

Average of first three numbers = 42

Average of last three numbers = 50

**Concept Used:**

Average = Total Sum of Values ÷ Total Number of Values

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the four numbers be a, b, c, d.

⇒ Average of four numbers = (a+b+c+d)/(4)

⇒ (a+b+c+d)/(4)=48

⇒ a + b + c + d = 48 × 4 = 192 → (1)

⇒ Average of first three numbers = (a+b+c)/(3)

⇒ (a+b+c)/(3)=42

⇒ a + b + c = 42 × 3 = 126 → (2)

⇒ Average of last three numbers = (b+c+d)/(3)=50

⇒ b + c + d = 50 × 3 = 150 → (3)

⇒ Putting the value of equation (2) into (1),

⇒ 126 + d = 192

⇒ d = 192 – 126 = 66

⇒ Putting the value of equation (3) into (1),

⇒ a + 150 = 192

⇒ a = 192 – 150 = 42

⇒ Average of first and fourth number = (a+d)/(2)=(66+42)/(2)

⇒ Average of first and last number = (108)/(2)=54

**Hence, the average of first and last number is 54**

questions.question: The total surface area of a hemisphere is 64.57 cm². Find its curved surface area.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total surface area of hemisphere = 64.57 cm²

**Concept Used:**

Total Surface Area of Hemisphere = 3pi r²

Curved Surface Area of Hemisphere = 2pi r²

**Calculation:**

Total Surface Area of hemisphere = 64.57

⇒ 3pi r²=64.57

We take pi =3.14

⇒ 3times 3.14times r²=64.57

⇒ r²=(64.57)/(9.42)=6.854

⇒ Curved Surface Area of hemisphere = 2times 3.14times 6.854=43.04 cm²

**Hence, the curved surface area of the hemisphere is 43.04 cm².**
